page.notes: Greek text is partly uncertain at several points (marked [?]), mainly the opening Greek words, the Greek in the Nemea sentence, the word after "Pythex fuit", the Greek before "dicitur", and the Greek before "hoc loco est". The printed numbers in the Nereid list are copied as printed, including "Artæa" read as "Actæa" and "Pfamathe" as printed. Possible printing error: "Pythex", "Hyginus etiam 51" and "Pronoë" are copied as printed. The text ends mid-word with a printed hyphen at the line end ("con-"), so the following page continues it.
